name: Itsu no Ma ni ka Kanojo wa...
source:
The main girl has been always shy and cries easily.
The main character has been offering help to her and always in love with her.

She went to a school for girls. There again, she is not talkative and intimidated by boys other than the main character.
However, she seems to have changed recently.

He starts feeling that she is distant and avoiding him.
And sometimes he sees a shadow of another man.
Since when had she changed that much...?

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE047717.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
女主人公一向害羞腼腆，而且很爱哭。
主人公始终帮助着她，也一直深爱着她。

她进入了一所女子学校。在那里，她依然沉默寡言，也害怕主人公以外的男生。
然而，最近的她似乎变了。

主人公开始觉得她在疏远、躲避自己。
有时，他还会看到另一个男人的身影。
她究竟是从什么时候开始变得如此不同的…？

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE047717.html]DLsite English[/url]]
